# Logistics 0.1.15 beta

This release clarifies the source layout: desktop hosting lives in `Python/desktop`, mobile hosting in `Python/mobile`, and packaging/deployment in `mobile_build`. Imports, manifests, build scripts, CI and documentation follow those names. Installed mobile app identities are preserved.

IDE Markdown links preserve the originating Read/Edit and Formatted/Source choices. Shared code and Markdown views use consistent syntax accents, and newly loaded formatted documents start at the beginning.

Raw validation evidence is kept locally and excluded from Git and release packages. Published repository history has been cleaned, and affected older releases removed. Back up local work and re-clone existing Git checkouts; avoid merging old history back into the cleaned repository. Existing extracted installations can use the normal release update path.

Manual EPUB page turns preserve the newly selected passage through later window resizing.

iOS reader page snapshots now resolve the native window getter before capture. Native transfer-settings validation follows the save action after adaptive layout, and desktop animation checks wait for completion.
